items.title: Is NVR (NVR) Undervalued After Earnings Or Still Trading At A Premium?
items.summary: NVR (NVR) is back in focus after third quarter earnings showed net income of US$248.61 million, down from US$342.69 million a year earlier, with both basic and diluted EPS also lower. NVR’s share price closed at US$6,024.72, with the 1-day share price return down 3.84% after the earnings release. That short-term weakness adds to a year-to-date share price decline of 17.23%, even though the 5-year total shareholder return of 15.85% still reflects more muted long run progress.
